notes: Two branches (the «ح» after «الليث بن سعد») are two groups; «كلاهما عن نافع» is the shared tail (rule 3).
«ابن، رمح» and «ابن، أبي فديك» keep their commas: one man each (rule 7). «- يعني ابن عثمان -» is a gloss, left out.
Variant group (rule 4): Laith's version has Nafi' say «حسبت أن ابن عمر قال», naming Ibn Umar as the Companion. It is a remark on that version, never a route of the main chain.
